subject.title: fix(media): bound ffmpeg conversion wait with a timeout

question: Should all unsupported-media conversions fail after 60 seconds, or should this repository use a different fixed deadline before landing the timeout behavior?
rationale: The code can enforce any chosen bound, but source inspection cannot determine how long legitimate conversions for supported attachment sizes may take on slower machines; selecting that compatibility policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the 60-second bound
options.body: After restoring Linux portability, land the current deadline as a practical ceiling that prevents indefinite attachment-resolution stalls.

options.title: Choose a longer fixed bound
options.body: Increase the deadline based on the slowest supported attachment-conversion expectations before merging.

options.title: Require broader timing evidence
options.body: Pause until representative large attachments are measured on slower supported hardware, then select the deadline from that evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept the 60-second bound
recommendation.body: After restoring Linux portability, land the current deadline as a practical ceiling that prevents indefinite attachment-resolution stalls.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release integration history makes Peter the best available owner for the supported-platform and timeout-default decision.
